task_name: Bayesian Constraints on Ultralight Bosons from Black Hole Superradiance

methodological_commitments.primary_framework: Bayesian statistical inference using full posterior distributions
methodological_commitments.physics_basis: Black hole superradiance (Penrose process for bosonic fields)
key_equations: alpha = G_N * M_BH * mu / (hbar * c) ≈ 0.22 * (M/30 Msol) * (mu/10^-12 eV)
Horizon angular velocity: Omega_H = (c^3/(2GM)) * a_* / (1 + sqrt(1 - a_*^2))
methodological_commitments.data_treatment: Full posterior samples (not point estimates) for BH mass and spin
methodological_commitments.constraint_derivation: Exclusion probability P(excluded|mu) from fraction of posterior samples satisfying superradiance conditions

required_artifacts.data_overview: Posterior distribution visualizations for both BHs
required_artifacts.main_results: Exclusion probability curves vs mu, upper limit values

named_methods_to_reproduce: Self-interaction suppression via Bosenova critical alpha
